gen-gf-unkempt-gf-jura: Scruffy and loud, Unkempt keeps its t crossbar and stem matched. Jura, a sans-serif of bent-wire strokes with s curves that open generously, gives the shouting headline something tidy to lean on.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-spline-sans-mono: Warnes stretches out wide, its ink strokes tapering away before they touch. Spline Sans Mono, a monospace with fixed-width, code-style letters, brings a precise, technical counterweight to all that flourish.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-truculenta: Ink that looks poured gives Luckiest Guy its cheerful, loud voice. Truculenta's compact, tall-x-height lettering is what steadies the pair, soaking up the shouting without losing its friendly roundness.
gen-megrim-gf-narnoor: Angular and futuristic, Megrim holds every stroke ending at a measured thickness. Megrim excels at striking shapes up top, while Narnoor, with short ascenders above big bowls, does the steadier, plainer talking.
gen-nixie-one-gf-biz-udgothic: A constant, neon-tube stroke from top to baseline defines Nixie One. Give Nixie One plenty of size so its curves glow; BIZ UDGothic, a sans-serif with wide bowl channels, can stay modest.
gen-nixie-one-gf-exo-2: Exo 2 brings curves with plenty of daylight inside, a sans with a crisp, professional air. Nixie One makes arches echo their stems, which is the pair's neatest trick.
gen-nixie-one-gf-k2d: Nixie One draws its open curves with clear gaps, glowing like retro tech. It earns its keep big and brief, while K2D, a sans-serif with tube-like thickness through every bend, takes over from there.
gen-nixie-one-gf-niramit: Nostalgic and retro-tech, Nixie One draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, from the first letter to the last. Niramit, a sans-serif, echoes that openness with gaping curves of its own.
gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan: Neon-tube glow, nostalgic and retro-tech: Nixie One keeps identical bar thickness across the whole line. Noto Sans Cypro Minoan, a contemporary sans-serif with terminals cut back to leave a big gap, gives that glow room to breathe.
gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Nixie One looks like laser-cut sheet, one stroke width throughout, with open curves and clear gaps in every letter. The heading makes the statement; Noto Sans Linear B smooths every bend.
